name: CutCraft v1.1.2 (F11 Full Screen Support & View Controls Release)
releaseNotes:
CutCraft v1.1.2 Release Update:
- Full Screen mode with F11 Function key: seamlessly toggle borderless full screen from anywhere in the application
- Escape key exit support: instantly exit full screen or dismiss overlay dialogues
- Top View menu and player transport toggle: easily enter or exit full screen from the menu bar or player controls
- Preview viewport double-click support: double-click the preview area to toggle between windowed and full screen
- Full screen screen reader announcements and status bar reporting
- Comprehensive test coverage and updated update manifest
